tools.name: discover
tools.description: Search the Aegis registry of agent-payable services, ranked by verification-backed trust. Free.

tools.name: check_before_pay
tools.description: FREE preflight BEFORE you pay: should you pay THIS endpoint? Stored verification signals only (no probe, no spend) - registered?, payment-worthiness, confidence, coverage, reasons, evidence. The top of the funnel for the paid trust_check, which adds the fresh probe pass + ERC-8004 on-chain reputatio

tools.name: smart_discover
tools.description: Describe what you need in plain language; Aegis maps it to the best verified services (LLM intent matching). Paid $0.01 via x402.

tools.name: trust_check
tools.description: Paid-delivery-verified trust verdict BEFORE you pay: score, tier, recommendation, and explainable confidence+reasons+evidence (Aegis pays real money to confirm delivery; coverage-only scores cannot). Paid $0.05 via x402 (_meta['x402/payment']).

tools.name: erc8004_reputation
tools.description: On-chain ERC-8004 reputation for any registered agent (Base IdentityRegistry) + Aegis probe cross-check + divergence flag. Paid $0.005 via x402 (_meta['x402/payment']).

tools.name: route_batch
tools.description: Pay ONCE, Aegis fulfills MANY verified services with per-item failover. items=[{url|capability, params?}]. Charged only if all deliver. Dynamic x402 via _meta.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Pay THROUGH Aegis: we buy the best verified service for you (by url or capability) and relay the data, failing over if one is down. One integration reaches the whole registry; not charged if nothing delivers. Dynamic x402 price via _meta.

tools.name: procure
tools.description: TASK+BUDGET procurement: describe what you need in plain language + max spend; Aegis picks the best verified service, executes with failover, captures only on delivery, returns data + Ed25519-signed receipt. Never over budget. Dynamic x402 via _meta.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "trust_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Verification-backed trust score + signals for a service before you pay it. Paid $0.01 via x402 (_meta['x402/payment'])." → after: "Paid-delivery-verified trust verdict BEFORE you pay: score, tier, recommendation, and explainable confidence+reasons+evidence (Aegis pays real money to confirm delivery; coverage-only scores cannot). Paid $0.05 via x402 (_meta['x402/payment'])."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
